claims.explanation: U-18666A inhibits intracellular cholesterol trafficking and DHCR24-mediated desmosterol conversion, causing lysosomal free cholesterol accumulation and disrupting lipid raft signaling. Selective killing tracks with high cholesterol synthesis/uptake capacity and pathway-activating mutations, while FBXW7 loss is protective. This suggests lipogenically addicted tumors are most vulnerable.
